target.title: Apply Claw skill artifacts
target.body:
## Summary

Implements the first follow-up track from openclaw/rfcs#27 for Claw skill artifacts, stacked after #102306.

- lets `claws apply --yes` install supported `skill` entries through existing OpenClaw skill installers
- supports ClawHub skill refs plus local/git source skill refs, with owner-qualified ClawHub refs normalized for lock/status checks
- records skill artifact provenance only for artifacts the apply path actually installed or verified as present
- preserves fail-closed diagnostics for unsupported skill package sources, malformed ClawHub refs, stale ClawHub lock-only state, and source-origin mismatches

## Stack

Base: `user/giodl/claws-pr7-export` (#102306)
RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs`
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --uncommitted` -> clean: no discrete correctness issues

Known unrelated blocker:

- `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` still stops on existing `src/secrets/config-io.ts(12,17)` TS4058 from the inherited stack.
